Type: dresser
Name: Amazon Brand - Solimo Tucana Engineered Wood Chest of Drawers (Walnut Durance Finish)
Colors: Walnut Durian
Premium-quality engineered wood chest of drawers which has undergone more than 20 safety and quality tests Material: European Standard Particle Board Smooth and curvilinear edges for protection against scrapes and cuts Earthy Walnut durance finish that gives it a warm look and makes cleaning an easy task Durable drawers that have been tested over 5,000 cycles Tested for resistance against humidity, stains and hot water Free from harmful carcinogens like lead, formaldehyde and pentachlorophenol (PCP) Comes with a 3-year warranty on manufacturing defects
